newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo wins 20 bln yen tanker order from Russia.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo wins 20 bln yen tanker order from Russia.

text.p: Japanese trading house Sumitomo Corp said on Wednesday it had received an order worth 20 billion yen for four 100,000-deadweight tonne (dwt) tankers from Russian shipping firm Novorossiysk Shipping Co.

The double-hulled tankers will be manufactured by steelmaker and shipbuilder NKK Corp, and the first vessel is scheduled to be delivered to the shipping firm in late 1998, a spokesman for Sumitomo Corp said.
This orders are the first a Japanese shipyard has won for large-sized tankers from Russia, which has traditionally placed its tanker orders with shipbuilders in eastern European countries, he said.
